# Diogo Maia Caetano

> Diogo Maia Caetano is a Product Design Leader based in Lisbon, Portugal, and one of the country's most experienced product designers. Over 11+ years, including 6+ at unicorns and NYSE-listed companies, he has led design for complex enterprise products, built design systems from scratch, and founded the collaborative music platform Jammin'. He pairs a visionary, systems-level view of products with hands-on craft.

## Highlights

- Lead Product Designer at 8x8 (NYSE: EGHT), 2022–2024: led the Integrations design vertical, partnering with Google, Microsoft and Salesforce; contributed to Work App, Jitsi and the Oxygen design system; mentored junior designers.
- Senior Product Designer at Feedzai (Portuguese fintech unicorn), 2021–2022: pioneered the company's design system.
- UX/UI Designer at OutSystems (Portuguese unicorn), 2020.
- Product Designer at AstraZeneca, 2025–2026: turned complex clinical and operational workflows into clear digital experiences.
- Product Designer at Sensei, 2025: designed Europe's first fully autonomous parapharmacy, including its web app, mobile app and design system.
- Integrated Designer at Taste Labs, 2026–now: critiques and art-directs AI-generated design to teach models good design taste.
- Founder and CEO of Jammin', a collaborative music platform.
- Five design systems and UI kits shipped (Sensei, 8x8 Oxygen, Feedzai, Papersoft, Apiax).

## Expertise

Design leadership, product strategy, design systems, enterprise SaaS, AI product design, FinTech, RegTech, Pharma and Health, Telecommunications, Retail, VR/AR and Music.

## What people say

- "His UI skills are unparalleled, and I always had complete trust in his design expertise." Vlad Derdeicea, Product Design Manager at 8x8
- "Diogo is not just a mentor but a role model." Ioana Boeriu, Product Designer at 8x8
- "Diogo is a strong leader that brings fresh ideas and constantly guided the team with clarity." Yasmine Lunt, Marketing Intern at Jammin'
